_doc: Registry of every repository in the ultrastable GitHub org. Source of truth for purpose, disposition and visibility. Checked by scripts/check_org_repos.py (in `checks`); live drift is detected by `python3 scripts/check_org_repos.py --live`. Archive is reversible; nothing is deleted.
why: Threads on 2026-11-10 created split repos (site, docs, platform, ip, business, seed) in parallel while the monorepo became the system of record, with no single page declaring it. They were archived as SUPERSEDED duplicates the same day. On 2026-11-11 the scope and license pivot split code from docs (workers, spec, license) and made patent drafts historical (ip).
visibility_rule: All repos are public under the Ultrastable License (owner decision 2026-11-15).

repos.name: .github
repos.purpose: Org profile README and community defaults, the public face of the org.
repos.note: Archived at creation; GitHub org page is optional. Public presence is ultrastable.io/org. Surface results in surface_results_2026_11_12.

repos.name: spec
repos.purpose: Architectural specifications (US-SPEC-*), product docs and the canonical license material (license/); replaces the dropped patent drafts, the docs repo and the license repo.

repos.name: ultrastable
repos.purpose: System of record: roadmap, doctrine, foundation, agents, ops, dashboard, site, outreach, brand, business and archived ip material.

repos.name: workers
repos.purpose: All product code: portable core, Cloudflare and GCP adapters, bootstrapper, console, gaplint, QNFO extraction.

repos.name: business
repos.purpose: Business plan, funding, investor kit; superseded by ultrastable/business/.
repos.reason: SUPERSEDED duplicate; content lives in ultrastable/business

repos.name: docs
repos.purpose: Early docs and issue JSON; superseded.
repos.reason: SUPERSEDED duplicate; docs live in ultrastable/docs and spec

repos.name: ip
repos.purpose: Historical patent drafts and evidence; patent dropped 2026-11-11.
repos.reason: SUPERSEDED duplicate; ultrastable/ip/ARCHIVED.md holds the history

repos.name: license
repos.purpose: Canonical Ultrastable License text, commercial terms, FAQ.
repos.note: Retired: content lives in spec/license/, this repo's README points to spec. Archiving is cosmetic and non-blocking; attempted via API and refused, so it is never required.
repos.reason: Folded into spec/license/ on 2026-11-12 (spec PR 9); one fewer repo for an investor to read. Backup bundle ultrastable-git/2026-11-12/license-backup.bundle.

repos.name: platform
repos.purpose: Python runtime and core; superseded by workers/runtimes.
repos.reason: SUPERSEDED duplicate; newer copy is workers/runtimes/python

repos.name: seed
repos.purpose: Template repository for systems launched at the front door: the tick Worker's administration app generates each visitor app repository from it (APP-REPO-1, seed/worker/src/apprepos.js ensureAppRepo spec.template), and tenant-repos.yml fills new seeds from it.
repos.reason: Revived 2026-11-25 as the launch template (LAUNCH-PATH-1); public under DISCOVER-1, which keeps only ultrastable/ops private.

repos.name: site
repos.purpose: Marketing site worker; superseded by ultrastable/site/.

public_presence.route: Cloudflare Worker site, deployed through the Cloudflare connector (docs/ops/SITE-DEPLOY.md), needs no person-supplied token
public_presence.github_org_page: staged at brand/public-profile/; goes live whenever .github becomes writable, never required
public_presence.confidentiality: ultrastable.io already serves generic pages. /org carries repository roles only (no repo links, no architecture, no QNFO or patent wording), enforced by site/site.test.mjs in checks. The patent track was dropped 2026-11-11, so there is no provisional-filed flag to wait on; the gate is the lint. A failing lint blocks the merge and therefore the deploy.

surface_results_2026_11_12.github_mcp_on_.github: refused: repository not configured for session
surface_results_2026_11_12.add_repo_.github: refused: dot-named repositories cannot be attached
surface_results_2026_11_12.connectors: two Cloudflare connectors, no GitHub connector; Cloudflare tokens cannot reach GitHub
surface_results_2026_11_12.session_proxy_settings_write: refused: repository settings writes are not permitted
surface_results_2026_11_12.archive_license_via_api: refused by the session permission check; not retried
surface_results_2026_11_12.device_bash: owner device not connected to the bridge
surface_results_2026_11_12.github_app_manifest_flow: needs an owner browser approval, so not a closed loop; not relied on
surface_results_2026_11_12.org_profile_from_other_repo: unsupported by GitHub; replaced by ultrastable.io/org
surface_results_2026_11_12.final_disposition: nothing in the investor-facing view depends on a person-supplied input
